fomod.Name: LipSync Together (Voice Lip Sync)
fomod.Author: mailamea10
fomod.Description: Moves your character's mouth while you talk into your microphone, and shows it to every other Skyrim Together Reborn player: talk to your friends through your characters. Voice only, no webcam; keyboard clicks and fan noise are ignored. Requires Mfg Fix NG (or Mfg Fix). Supports Skyrim Together Reborn 1.8.3 from Nexus (Skyrim 1.7.104 and 1.6.1170/1.6.1179) and Skyrim Together Reborn 1.8.5 (Skyrim 1.7.104, 1.6.1170/1.6.1179 and 1.5.97).
